subject: Short-term burst ceiling exception & staged commit split
messages:
From: Olivia Nguyen <olivia@brightcart.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Urgent: launch week burst capacity request

Hi Vivek / Monica,

We have an unexpected traffic spike for BrightCart's mobile checkout integration — traffic looks like 4x our baseline for the next 72 hours as a staged marketing push went live earlier than planned. Our engineering team expects sustained peak of ~1200 req/s (95th), average payload ~40 tokens per request.

We need a short-term quota uplift and higher rate limit for the next 3 days (starting now). Can Redwood temporarily raise our burst ceiling so we don't hit throttles? We want the simplest path: temporary uplift, a short pro-rata true-up on usage for the window, and an option to convert some of that uplift into a committed partial monthly allocation after the spike (if we see sustained demand).

Attached: BrightCart_release_plan.pdf (launch plan). Procurement is looping in procurement@brightcart.com for paperwork.

Can you confirm cost for ephemeral uplift vs. converting to a blended committed commit? We need quick numbers to decide.

Thanks,
Olivia
Head of Integrations, BrightCart

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Nguyen <olivia@brightcart.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: launch week burst capacity request

Monica / Karthik — looping you in. Olivia, thanks for the heads up and the plan. We can cover this, but we should be explicit about the mechanics so procurement can sign off quickly. Proposal (fast path):

- Immediate: Temporary uplift to 2.5x baseline (sufficient to cover the 1200 req/s peak) for 72 hours.
- Metering: We will meter extra tokens consumed during uplift window and invoice as a pro-rata overrun at our short-window overrun rate.
- Convert option: If BrightCart converts >=50% of the uplifted capacity into a 12-month partial commit within 30 days, we will rebate 25% of the billed uplift overrun (applied as credit to next invoice) and apply a blended committed rate going forward.
- Thresholds & caps: uplift will be capped at the uplifted QPS; sustained usage beyond 7 days triggers a conversion talk.

Action items for us: Monica, please prepare a quick pricing sheet (per-token overrun rate for the 72h window + blended commit alternative) and a short DocuSign amendment that covers uplift dates and conversion terms. Karthik, confirm we can route the requests to the Dedicated pool with immediate effect and that autoscale will not reconfigure existing commitments.

Olivia — can you confirm the exact expected token volume for the 72h window (rough estimate is fine) and whether legal wants a short amendment or a PO will be sufficient?

- Vivek

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Olivia Nguyen <olivia@brightcart.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: launch week burst capacity request

On Tue, May 18, 2026 at 9:12 AM Olivia Nguyen <olivia@brightcart.com> wrote:
> We have an unexpected traffic spike for BrightCart's mobile checkout integration — traffic looks like 4x our baseline for the next 72 hours as a staged marketing push went live earlier than planned.

Thanks for the plan, Vivek. Olivia — based on the rough numbers you shared, attached is a quick pricing workbook (burst_pricing_calculation.xlsx) and a one-page amendment draft. Summary: 

- Short-window overrun rate (72h uplift): $0.020 per 1k tokens (pro-rata aggregated for the uplift window).
- If BrightCart converts >=50% of uplift into a 12-month commit within 30 days, Redwood will credit 25% of the charged uplift amount back to BrightCart (credit applied to next invoice).
- If converted commit is accepted, the blended committed rate for converted volume would be $0.012 per 1k tokens for the remainder of the term.
- No minimum conversion required beyond the >=50% threshold.

Operational notes: Karthik confirmed we can steer the uplift to a Dedicated pool and we can complete routing within ~20 minutes of sign-off.

Next steps: Olivia to confirm token estimate and procurement preference (DocuSign amendment vs. PO), we’ll prepare DocuSign envelope and flip the routing switch once signed.

Regards,
Monica
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

Attachments: burst_pricing_calculation.xlsx (summary tab), amendment_short_window.docx

From: Olivia Nguyen <olivia@brightcart.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightcart.com
Date: 2026-05-19T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: launch week burst capacity request

Thanks — that all looks workable. We estimate ~3.2M tokens over the 72h window (based on 1200 req/s * 40 tokens * 72h * utilization factor). Procurement prefers a single DocuSign amendment for clarity. Can you send the DocuSign link and a compact cost breakdown (one-page) we can attach to the PO approval?

Also: please call out SLA on throttling for the uplift window and whether Redwood will guarantee no mid-window throttles if routing is applied to Dedicated pool. We need that explicitly for internal launch sign-off.

If we get the DocuSign and the cost summary within the hour we'll sign and you can flip the route.

Appreciate the quick turn,
Olivia
